headline: Pakistan has assumed the chairmanship of the Intergovernmental Group of Twenty-Four (G-24), with Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb calling for a more inclusive, fair and development-oriented global financial system, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Aurangzeb ne fair global financial system ka mutalba kiya.

caption:
Pakistan G-24 ka chairman ban gaya!
Business Recorder ke mutabiq Finance Division ne Sunday ko bataya ke Pakistan ne Intergovernmental Group of Twenty-Four (G-24) ki chairmanship sambhal li hai. Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb ne zyada inclusive, fair aur development par mabni global financial system ka mutalba kiya, aur PM Shehbaz Sharif ne ise "significant diplomatic milestone" qarar diya.
Kya is se Pakistan ki awaz duniya mein mazboot hogi? Comment mein batayein 👇
